newsitem.title: DENMARK: Carlsberg fall weighs Danish index down.
newsitem.headline: Carlsberg fall weighs Danish index down.

text.p: Danish brewer Carlsberg led a fall on the Danish stock exchange on Friday after Britain blocked a planned sale of its half of the Carlsberg-Tetley joint venture to partner Bass.
Analysts believed that the market overeacted to the news although the bourse itself was expected to drift lower next week in the grip of summer lethargy.
"Monday will be relatively quiet, with a downward tendency, everybody's getting ready to go on holiday," a dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index fell 0.41 point to 170.82, in overall bourse turnover of 1.3 billion crowns.
